as_written_in_papers.quote: A genetic test revealed a hemizygous mutation in the LAMP2 gene (LAMP2: c.963G > A: Figure 2).
Gene sequencing verified that the proband carried the mutation c.963G > A in the LAMP-2 gene.

cases.statement: The two batch rows are 16-year-old male probands from Anhui with WPW/pre-excitation and HCM: 35669483 Pt 1 (hemizygous) and 37568080 III-1 (zygosity not stated). They are very likely the same person (see concerns). 35669483 also reports five relatives with the 'similar' or same variant who are not in the batch; they are listed here as identity 'not in batch'.

people.label: Pt 1
people.key_phenotypes: ventricular pre-excitation with AVRT; LV hypertrophy; raised CK and transaminases; patchy delayed enhancement on MRI; low school performance; motor function and muscle strength normal

quotes.quote: The proband (Pt 1) was a male aged 16 years who was admitted to hospital for palpitation.
The narrow QRS tachycardia indicated atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia (Figures 1A,B).
Echocardiography detected hypertrophy in the ventricular septum and left ventricular wall (Supplementary Figure 2).
The serum concentrations of creatine kinase (1129.6 U/L), alanine transferase, and aspartate aminotransferase were higher than normal.
The patient reported average muscular strength, but low performance in primary school (not verified by professional tests).

people.label: III-1
people.zygosity_or_genotype: carrier; zygosity not stated (male, X-linked gene)
people.key_phenotypes: WPW; concentric HCM; abnormal cognitive function / intellectual disability; decreased muscle strength; raised CK, AST, ALT

quotes.quote: The proband (III-1) was a 16-year-old male who had been previously reported [7].
He was previously diagnosed with Wolf-Parkinson-White (WPW) syndrome and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM).
He also displayed abnormal cognitive function and decreased muscle strength.
Cine images show concentric hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
Catheter ablation was performed a year earlier, but the effect was not satisfactory.

people.label: Pt 2 (II4)
people.zygosity_or_genotype: 'similar mutation' as in Pt 1; zygosity not stated
people.key_phenotypes: HCM then dilated cardiomyopathy; AVRT; complete LBBB; atrial fibrillation; heart failure needing CRT-D

quotes.quote: Pt 1’s mother (Pt 2), aged 38 years, was repeatedly admitted to hospital due to palpitation, chest tightness, short of breath or low endurance to activity.

From 2003 to 2021, the patient’s condition aggravated bit by bit, successively developing dilated cardiomyopathy, complete left bundle branch block (CLBBB), ventricular premature beats with a QRS wave width of 150 ms (Figures 3A,B), and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (Figure 3C).
The genetic testing unveiled a similar mutation in LAMP2, as in Pt 1 (Figure 2).

Heart MRI showed diffuse late gadolinium enhancement in the subendocardium and midmyocardium of the left ventricular wall (Supplementary Figure 9).

phenotype_specificity.statement: In both reports the proband shows HCM with pre-excitation and raised CK. The authors present this combination in a young male as suggestive of Danon disease (a general statement). 37568080 notes the proband's myopathy and cognitive problems were absent in the female relatives. No paper reports testing of other genes or biopsy.

quotes.quote: Therefore, HCM accompanied with pre-excitation syndrome in a young male strongly implies DD.
In our group, the male patient (III-1) suffered from mild muscle weakness and cognitive dysfunction, while the female patients (II-2 and II-3) did not.

segregation.statement: 35669483: the proband plus five relatives are reported with the 'similar' or same LAMP2 variant: the mother (Pt 2, affected), the maternal aunt (Pt 3, LGE and arrhythmia), a second aunt (Pt 4, mild ECG change only) and Pt 4's two sons (Pt 5 with hypertrophy at 8 years; Pt 6 with a thickened wall at 2 years). The father (II3) was sequenced, but his result is not stated in the text. No tested non-carriers are reported in the text. In 37568080 the mother (II-2) and aunt (II-3) are affected, but the text does not say they were genotyped.

de_novo.statement: Not de novo per 35669483: the proband's mother (Pt 2) is reported to carry a 'similar' LAMP2 variant. Testing of the mother's parents is not reported. 37568080 states that the maternal grandfather had died 20 years earlier.

The father of patients II-2 and II-3 had died 20 years earlier.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Single-nucleotide change predicted from the batch HGVS to create a stop codon, p.(Trp321Ter). Neither paper states a protein change. 37568080 states LAMP-2 deficiency as the disease mechanism in general.

quotes.quote: The primary deficiency of LAMP-2 causes disruption of autophagy, leading to impaired fusion of lysosomes.

authors_classification.statement: No classification is stated. 35669483 calls the variant novel.

quotes.quote: In the present study, the c.963G > A mutation was a novel discovery.

concerns: Probable same person: 35669483 Pt 1 (DANON-ID0211) and 37568080 III-1 (DANON-ID0196). Both papers come from Fuyang People's Hospital, Anhui (both ethics statements). Both describe a 16-year-old male proband with WPW/pre-excitation, HCM, a prior ablation and school or cognitive problems, with an affected mother (38 vs 37) and an affected maternal aunt (40 vs 39). Pedigree labels differ (III4/II4/II2 vs III-1/II-2/II-3).
37568080 says its proband 'had been previously reported [7]'. It cites Xie et al. 2022 (PMID 35299984), not 35669483, so a third report of the same boy may exist outside this batch.

Contradictions between the two reports if they describe the same boy: 'Motor function and muscle strength are normal' (35669483) vs 'decreased muscle strength' with skeletal myopathy 'Yes' (37568080). Ablation removed the pre-excitation (35669483) vs 'the effect was not satisfactory' (37568080). The mother developed dilated cardiomyopathy (35669483) vs an HCM phenotype for the mother and DCM for the aunt (37568080).
Carriers missing from the batch: 35669483 Pt 2, Pt 3, Pt 4, Pt 5 and Pt 6 are reported with the variant but are not batch rows (the extraction has a variant row for Pt 5).

Relatives are described as carrying a 'similar mutation' to Pt 1. Only Pt 5 is described as 'the mutation of LAMP2 as in Pt 1', so the identity of the relatives' variant is implied rather than stated.

No transcript or protein change is stated in either paper. Zygosity is stated only for 35669483 Pt 1. In 37568080, II-2 and II-3 are called patients 'according to the clinical data', with no genotype stated.
notes_for_panel: Probably one proband reported twice (Fuyang, Anhui), plus up to five maternal relatives with the variant in 35669483: two affected adult women, one mildly affected woman and two young boys with ventricular thickening. Genotype statements for relatives are loosely worded ('similar mutation').
